quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #24
										  					
  

20 Questions • Passing Score 15

questions.question: When parking uphill on a hill with a curb, which way should you turn your front wheels?

options.text: Turn your front wheels sharply toward the curb.
Turn your front wheels slightly to the right.
Turn your front wheels sharply away from the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your front wheels sharply away from the curb.
questions.explanation: Turn your front wheels sharply away from the curb when parked facing uphill. This stops your vehicle from rolling into traffic if the brakes fail. If there is no curb, turn your wheels sharply toward the edge of the road instead.

questions.question: You may exceed the speed limit to pass another vehicle.
questions.explanation: You must obey the speed limit at all times. Never exceed the speed limit, even when passing another vehicle.

questions.question: You are parking uphill on a two-way road with no curb. Which way should you turn your front wheels?

options.text: Right, toward the side of the road
Left, toward the center of the road

questions.correctAnswerText: Right, toward the side of the road
questions.explanation: When parking uphill or downhill on a road with no curb, turn your wheels so the vehicle will roll away from the center of the road if the brakes fail.

questions.question: If you park facing uphill on a street with a curb, set the parking brake and turn your front wheels:
questions.explanation: When parking uphill on a street with a curb, turn your wheels away from the curb. When parking uphill on a street without a curb or when parking downhill, turn your wheels toward the curb or edge of the road.

questions.question: Driving is a right, not a privilege.
questions.explanation: Driving is a privilege, not a right. The state grants this privilege only to people who can show they have the knowledge and ability to drive safely. Misusing this privilege can result in losing your driver license.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: Your vehicle is blocking traffic after an accident. What should you do?

options.text: Move your vehicle off the traveled portion of the roadway, if possible.
Do not move your vehicle under any circumstances.
Wait until police arrive before moving your vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move your vehicle off the traveled portion of the roadway, if possible.
questions.explanation: After a minor accident, move your vehicle off the traveled portion of the roadway if you can. Always identify yourself and help if needed.

questions.question: What is the speed limit on a four-lane divided highway if no other limit is posted?
questions.explanation: The speed limit on a four-lane divided highway is 70 miles per hour unless a different limit is posted. Follow any posted speed limit signs.

questions.question: When driving in fog, use your high beam headlights.
questions.explanation: Use your low beam headlights when driving in fog. High beams reflect off the fog and can blind you.

questions.question: Why should you be careful when passing a bicycle?

options.text: You are moving faster than the bicycle.
The bicycle always has the right-of-way.
Oncoming traffic may not see you pass the bicycle.
The cyclist may have to swerve into traffic to avoid an object on the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: The cyclist may have to swerve into traffic to avoid an object on the road.
questions.explanation: Be cautious when passing a bicycle because the cyclist may suddenly swerve into traffic to avoid something on the road. Always drive carefully near bicyclists.

questions.question: When parallel parking facing downhill, what should you do with your wheels?

options.text: Turn your wheels sharply toward the curb.
Turn your wheels away from the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your wheels sharply toward the curb.
questions.explanation: When parking downhill, turn your wheels toward the curb. When parking uphill without a curb, turn your wheels toward the road edge. When parking uphill with a curb, turn your wheels away from the curb.

questions.question: What are signs called that require drivers to follow their instructions?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell drivers what they must do. If you do not follow them, you can be punished.

questions.question: What should you do when approaching a railroad crossing with no traffic signals?

options.text: Always come to a complete stop.
Slow down and be ready to stop.
All railroad crossings have signals, so this never happens.
Speed up to cross the tracks quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: At an unmarked railroad crossing, slow down and prepare to stop. Look both ways on all tracks before crossing. If you see or hear a train, stop at a safe distance from the nearest track and wait until the train passes.

questions.question: Is it illegal for a car to share a lane with a motorcycle?
questions.explanation: Motorcycles have the right to use a full lane. Two motorcycles can share a lane, but cars must never share a lane with a motorcycle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about road conditions and hazards ahead. This sign warns you that traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to let traffic merge safely.

questions.question: When two vehicles reach an uncontrolled intersection at the same time, who has the right-of-way?

options.text: The vehicle on the left must yield to the vehicle on the right
The vehicle on the right must yield to the vehicle on the left

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle on the left must yield to the vehicle on the right
questions.explanation: At an uncontrolled intersection, if two vehicles arrive at the same time, the driver on the left must yield to the driver on the right. The left driver can go when it is safe.

questions.question: In normal weather and traffic, what is the minimum following distance?
questions.explanation: Keep a three-second distance between your car and others in normal conditions. This gives you time to react if another driver makes a mistake. Increase this distance in bad weather or heavy traffic.

questions.question: How much alcohol does the body process in one hour?
questions.explanation: The average person's body processes about one drink per hour. Many things affect how impaired someone becomes, including the amount of alcohol, how fast it is consumed, body weight, food intake, and overall health.

questions.question: What is important to do before turning left?

options.text: Swing to the right side of your lane
Wait until oncoming traffic has a red light

questions.explanation: When turning left at a traffic signal, you must let pedestrians and oncoming traffic go first.

questions.question: What should you do if another car is tailgating you on a two-lane road?

options.text: Slowly reduce your speed to let the tailgater pass you
Speed up to increase the distance between the cars
Tap your brakes to slow down, then resume your speed

questions.correctAnswerText: Slowly reduce your speed to let the tailgater pass you
questions.explanation: If being tailgated, switch lanes if possible. If you cannot switch lanes, slowly reduce your speed. This encourages the tailgater to pass you.
